Data.title: Total Requirement Coefficients In Terms Of Value Added By Broad Sector, 2010
Data.footnote: This table is commonly known as the Value Added Multipliers Table. Each column shows the total direct and indirect value added generated by industries for every 1,000 units of an industry’s final output.
